builder.objective: REPAIR V3-03: Implement a single merged cursor-based pagination across the unified stream (e.g., page by occurredAt over both repos with one cursor and dedupe/merge deterministically, or fetch per-type pages keyed to the merged cursor), remove the hard 150-entry cap so every loaded page is visible, and add tests covering the two-repo merged pagination path (no duplicates, no skipped entries, older pages reachable).; Add PersistentTask shortcuts to the contribution form (prefill label/value/beneficiaries from the selected PersistentTask), a date/heure selector for occurredAt, and a share action for entries (via the existing share port, honest adapter), keeping the form compact and chrono-free.
builder.scope: Repair only the audited must-fix findings on the preserved V3 baseline; do not rebuild accepted work.
